newsitem.title: INDIA: Around 1,000 fishermen safe after India cyclone.
newsitem.headline: Around 1,000 fishermen safe after India cyclone.

text.p: Around 1,000 fishermen who have been missing for six days reached land and safety on Tuesday following a cyclone which devastated the south east Indian coast last week, officials said.
"At an average of six to eight persons per boat, we think about 1,000 persons have returned to safety", an official at the Andhra Pradesh state relief control room in Hyderabad told PTI.
